name: rate-limiter
title: Sliding-window rate limiter
prompt:
Implement `SlidingWindowLimiter(limit, window, clock=time.monotonic)` in `limiter.py`:
- `allow(key)` returns True and records the event if fewer than `limit` events for `key` happened
  in the last `window` seconds (an event at time t still counts while `now - t < window`);
  otherwise returns False. Rejected calls are NOT recorded.
- `retry_after(key)`: seconds until `allow(key)` would succeed (0 if it would succeed now)
- keys are independent; `clock` is a zero-argument function returning seconds (tests inject a fake)
- `limit` must be an int >= 1 and `window` a number > 0, otherwise `ValueError`
